title: ボーノなレースに必要なもの！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while we're devising a strategy for the Mile Ch., Hishi Akebono calls out to me excitedly.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh! Look, Trainer! Taiki is on TV!

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle has been making a name for herself over the past year. In fact, her growth is showing no signs of slowing down.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: What's the driving force behind her success, you ask? Why, it's her desire to overcome a certain racer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That's right! My goal is to take down Hishi Akebono!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I went all out preparin' for the last Sprinters S. so I could ensure my victory!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I trained every day from dawn till dusk and did pair running with different friends of mine!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I cut out all my snacks too and exercised until I was nothin' but muscles!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But I still didn't win! Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It sucks real bad right now, but I'm still havin' a lot of fun! I swear I won't lose the next one, though!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even through the screen, I can tell Taiki Shuttle is stronger and faster than she was during the Sprinters S. last month.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let's win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She hoists me over her shoulder in an instant and takes off running. This time, I already know where we're going.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And I find I'm correct as we skid into the kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: My size is my strength!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm so powerful and can deal with getting blocked on the track so well!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Which means if I bulk up and get even more muscular, I'll be more powerful than ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Status quo notwithstanding, I'm not sure her legs can handle the strain if she gets any larger than she is now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The very thought sends a thread of anxiety through me. However…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I want to get so big and strong that I'll be able to beat Taiki Shuttle without a doubt!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I decided to race my way, and I wanna go all-out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's right. We already made the decision together, so now's the time to take action.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thanks, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right! Now that that's out of the way, I'll make us poached chicken and broccoli salad for lunch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono starts cooking right away. She sets a pot of water to boil, then begins slicing up chicken breast meat.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The trick is to poke holes in the meat with a fork and massage it well with salt and sake.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: After that, let it rest for a while. In the meantime, we can make the sauce.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I think I'll use soy sauce, sugar, sake, and sesame oil today! Oh! I can't forget to mince some white onions while I'm at it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She mixes the sauce and slices cucumbers to act as a base for the rest of the food. The water starts boiling while she's cutting the broccoli.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh! I gotta sprinkle on the starch! Not too much at a time, now… Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Next, it's time to poach the chicken.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It has to cook all the way through to be safe to eat, but it'll get too chewy if it gets overcooked. It's a tough balance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She then scoops out the cooked chicken breasts and cools them in a bowl of ice water.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once the meat has cooled, she drains the water and puts the finishing touches on the broccoli salad. And just like that…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Soup's on! Ta-dah! Presenting a heaping helping of poached chicken and broccoli salad! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small mountain of food gets plopped down in front of me with a thud.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Enjoy, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Here's to our next victory! I'll win it with my—no, with our very own running!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The chicken and broccoli couldn't be more perfect, and the two of us practically devour it together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before long, the plates are empty.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Whew! I'm full to bursting! That was so tasty! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that we both have fuel in our tanks, it's time to hash out a plan moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take out my training handbook to look up what kind of strength training is effective for building muscles, when I hear giggling.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, nothing. It's just, well…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It almost feels like with the two of us together, we could do anything!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following that, we ramp up training even more to reach the victory in our sights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as the Mile Ch. draws closer, a reporter comes to do an interview with Hishi Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Who's my rival? It's Taiki Shuttle, of course. ☆

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Really! Wow, this is a showdown between fated rivals, then, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm training hard right now so I can race Taiki at my very best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I've put on lots and lots of muscle too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Look!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono barely finishes speaking when I feel my feet leave the ground.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Upsy-daisy!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Wow! I can't believe how easily you're able to lift up your trainer with one arm…

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Correct me if I'm wrong, but you're a full size bigger than you were at the Sprinters S., aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe! You're right!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'll be more powerful than ever on the track, so look forward to it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's the first challenge Hishi Akebono has ever publicly issued, and it becomes the talk of the town in no time.
